# Site Deployment Memo - Gretna Marsh Pilot

From: Dr. Marta Ovist, site lead. Date: 2031-03-05. To: field crew, all shifts. Subject: specification figures to quote in site paperwork.

## 1. Why this memo exists

Inspectors have twice quoted superseded or distributor figures back to us. From today, every site form must quote the controlling figures from the Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 2, and only that document.

## 2. The cadence rule, quoted

For the record, this memo quotes the specification directly: "Calibration interval: 90 days under normal service." That sentence is the one inspectors accepted last quarter, and the crew should reuse it verbatim whenever a form asks for the service cycle.

## 3. Working figures for the Gretna Marsh Pilot

- Site: Gretna Marsh Pilot, Province of Alderbury.
- Probes in service: 38, spread across 6 plots.
- Permit: WPB-2049-1187, issued 2030-10-02.
- Calibration logging: within 24 hours of every event, no exceptions.
- The 30-minute cadence figure some crew members remember comes from the superseded Revision 1 and must not appear on any form dated after 2031-02-01.

## 4. Vendor separation

We also bench-test one HydraProbe-9 unit from Voss AgriTech. It runs a 10-minute cadence on a 60-day factory cycle and is a completely separate product line. Its figures belong only on the comparison bench sheet, never on Aeris-M deployment forms.

## 5. Housekeeping

Shift leads initial the register at handover. Damaged probes go to quarantine per the safety datasheet; nobody opens a housing for any reason. The next scheduled board report is due 2031-06-15 and will cite the specification revision in force on that date.

## 6. Forms and register habits

Deployment forms cite the specification revision in force on the form's date, never the revision in force at probe installation. Register corrections append with a cross-reference; nobody edits a line that an inspector has already initialed. Bench sheets for the HydraProbe-9 stay on the bench clipboard and travel nowhere else, and the DSV-44 return form is collected from the manufacturer portal rather than from the distributor, whose stock note says they do not carry it.
